prompt: If I went to a zoo, which animals should I see first?
response: When visiting a zoo, it's best to see the animals you're least interested in first, as they are often the most unique and less commonly seen. This way, you can tackle the harder-to-see animals early on and avoid missing them due to fatigue. It's a good strategy to ensure you cover all areas of the zoo, even if it means starting with less familiar species.
